english.meaning: short by just a tiny bit
english.note: Stronger than 爭啲, a bit short.

exampleSentences.english: But if I’m a little short, you’re even shorter. No big deal.
exampleSentences.traditional: 但係如果我爭啲，噉𠻺你爭啲啲囖。無嘢𡃉。
